_status: THE MONEY-CAPABLE EXECUTOR. This manifest RECORDS the Railway service-level configuration that was already in force; it grants nothing and changes no effective setting. Every field was read back from the live service before being written here, so committing it is a no-op at deploy time and a reviewable record thereafter. WATCH PATTERN IS A SAFETY PROPERTY: this service deploys only when DEPLOY_TRIGGER changes, so ordinary code pushes cannot restart a process that may hold a resting order. Trading permission is NOT here and never will be: it is L5_SHADOW_ONLY plus the owner arm token plus the durable halt latch, all outside this file.
